title: 第7章 灵虫免魅力斩妖女第8章 杀人如麻也配正道
content_zh:
夜晚的大泽被瘴气所遮蔽，不见星月，万物沉寂，唯有不知名虫豸的低鸣。
木屋静立，仿佛与黑暗融为一体。
屋内，正汲取着微薄元阴灵气的茅不易身体猛地一震，复眼骤然亮起碧绿的光芒！
“嗯，这些人还真是不消停啊！”
数道鬼魅般的影子，趁着夜色与环境融为一体，悄无声息地朝着木屋逼近。
但他们在茅不易强大的神识面前宛若聚光灯下乱窜的老鼠一般，根本无处避形。
为首的黑影打了个手势，众人瞬间散开，将木屋团团围住，封死了所有的逃脱路线。
随后一股无形的灵力波动如同蛛网般罩向木屋。
这是合欢宗的“迷情散”，能让人在甜美的梦中沉沦。
“球球，你怎么，不可以这样！”陈欣欣突然俏脸微红，说起梦话来。
听到陈欣欣的声音，茅不易缓缓飞入其怀中。
突然欣欣猛地将茅不易抱紧，嘴里叽里咕噜的说着他听不懂的梦话。
“怎么回事！”
茅不易展开神识，感受着周围的灵气波动，发现了一缕缕粉色的奇异的灵气波动。
“欣欣来！到我这来，我将带你坠入天国，永享极乐！”
妖姬的声音柔软酥骨，顺着窗户传入房内。
欣欣听到声音，紧闭双眼，缓缓起身朝着门外走去。
看着欣欣的走出了房门，茅不易心中天人交战。
“管不管？”
“如果管了，既会暴露自己，还会惹得强敌。”

“今后怕不是永无宁日，甚至会有生命之危！”
“趋利避害，是我本能，这少女于我何干，帮过她一次也算仁至义尽了。”
就当毛不易要飞走时，突然一股莫名的烦躁如同触手一般，紧紧的缠住茅不易。
脑海中不断浮现与欣欣朝夕相处的画面，不论他如何开解自己，都未得半分缓解。
“我不是人，我是虫！趋利避害才是我的天性！”
越是如此想到，那烦躁的感觉越盛。
他复眼之中的世界再度变得血红，六肢忍不住的剧烈颤抖起来。
“心魔，怎么又是心魔，是那老头给我下的血咒吗？”
“不对，自从我炼化了那名修士之后，脑子里便多了许多不属于我的东西！”
“从那之后我便如此！”
“不对，都不对！”
“我到底怎么了！我变成了什么东西！”
content_en:
At night, the swamp was obscured by miasma, and there were no stars or moon. Everything was silent except for the low hum of unknown insects.
The wooden house stood silently, as if blending into the darkness.
In the room, Mao Buyi, who was absorbing the meager amount of Yuan Yin spiritual energy, suddenly shook his body, and his compound eyes suddenly lit up with a green light!
"Well, these people really don't stop!"
Several ghostly shadows took advantage of the night to blend in with the environment and silently approached the wooden house.
But in front of Mao Buyi's powerful consciousness, they were like rats scurrying under the spotlight, with nowhere to hide.
The leading shadow made a gesture, and everyone dispersed instantly, surrounding the wooden house and blocking all escape routes.
Then an invisible wave of spiritual power enveloped the wooden house like a spider web.
This is the "Love Powder" of the Hehuan Sect, which can make people fall into sweet dreams.
"Qiuqiu, what are you doing? You can't do this!" Chen Xinxin suddenly blushed and started talking in her sleep.
Hearing Chen Xinxin's voice, Mao Buyi slowly flew into his arms.
Suddenly Xinxin hugged Mao Buyi tightly, mumbling words in his sleep that he couldn't understand.
"What's going on!"
Mao Buyi unfolded his consciousness, felt the fluctuations of spiritual energy around him, and discovered wisps of strange pink spiritual energy fluctuations.
"Come Xinxin! Come to me, I will take you to heaven and enjoy eternal bliss!"
The enchantress's voice was soft and crisp, and passed into the room along the window.
Xinxin heard the sound, closed her eyes tightly, stood up slowly and walked towards the door.
Seeing Xinxin walk out of the room, Mao Buyi felt a war between heaven and man in his heart.
"Do you care?"
"If you ignore it, you will expose yourself and provoke powerful enemies."
"I'm afraid there will be no peace in the future, and my life may even be in danger!"
"It is my instinct to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages. What does this girl have to do with me? I have done my best to help her once."
Just when Mao Buyi was about to fly away, an inexplicable irritability suddenly wrapped around Mao Buyi tightly like a tentacle.
Pictures of spending time with Xinxin day and night kept popping up in his mind, and no matter how much he tried to comfort himself, he couldn't get any relief.
"I'm not a human, I'm an insect! It's my nature to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages!"
The more I think about it, the more irritable I feel.
The world in his compound eyes turned blood red again, and his six limbs couldn't help but tremble violently.
"Inner demon, why is it the inner demon again? Was it the blood curse that the old man put on me?"
"No, since I refined that monk, there are many things in my mind that don't belong to me!"
"That's how I've been since then!"
"No, none of it is right!"
"What happened to me! What did I become!"
